description.value: Café Soleil is a Starbucks-licensed café tucked inside the Village Day Lodge at Sun Peaks Resort, positioned right at the base of the Sunburst Express and Sundance Express chairlifts. It offers handcrafted espresso drinks, drip coffee, hot breakfast, deli sandwiches, and fresh baked goods — a convenient fuel stop for mountain bikers riding the resort's extensive bike park network. Sun Peaks is BC's second-largest four-season mountain resort, making this a natural gathering point for cyclists and hikers.
